sections.appearance: Hasumi possess a tall and curvaceous figure, and has a black long hair reaching her waist with loose bangs and dark red eyes. She has a large black wings on her back. She has a mole under her left eye. Halo ==== Hasumi's halo has four red sharp daggers surrounding her halo. A four-point star fills the inner portion of the ring. Uniform ==== She wears the standard Justice Realization Committee uniform: a black with light red accents sailor shirt and skirt, and also a black choker. The word "Justice" is written under the breast pocket of her sailor shirt, and the Trinity logo is on her left sleeve. She completes the uniform with a red tie, black short gloves that reach only at the back of her hand, and black stockings with lace stocking welts and garter straps. Her skirt falls just below the knees and has a side slit on her right thigh, just large enough to reveal the lace garter belt and the strap of her black panties underneath. She also wears black shoes. Firearm ==== thumb|Impalement|150px She uses a black Pattern 1914 Enfield bolt action battle rifle with gold ornaments decorated all over the weapon. A gold Trinity insignia is imprinted on the stock.

sections.personality: As vice president of the Justice Realization Committee, she's composed and cool-headed, standing in contrast to the more aggressive and battle-frenzied Tsurugi. Because of this, she handles most of the club's day-to-day affairs. She bears a strong prejudice against Gehenna students to the point where Nagisa considered it a political liability in the leadup to the Eden Treaty. It was slightly decreased by the time of the Halo Games due to the amicable purpose behind it, however her angst towards the students from that academy reignited when she confronted the Hot Spring Development Department alongside Nakamasa Ichika during the event The Promise of The Summer Sky, where they were both overcame by the strength of their forewoman Shimokura Megu. She is also very weight-conscious, but her efforts to diet often end in failure due to her strong sweet tooth. Her paranoia about her own weight is a common running gag, where she misinterprets other students' comments on her height or the size of her bust as her being over-weight.
